import sys,json,unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tests')
import test_taxonomy_comparison as t
t.LOG_ROOT=Path('results/taxonomy_comparison/finish_20261116/tests_added')
t.LOG_ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
names=['test_mutated_'+x for x in ['both_match_reads','both_diff_reads','only_a_reads','only_b_reads','neither_reads','total_reads','total_asv','manifest_uuid']]
names += ['test_wrong_qza_uuid','test_wrong_role_without_missing_files','test_missing_asv_in_table','test_empty_output_file','test_extra_tsv_cell','test_consistent_scaling_keeps_fractions_but_is_wrong','test_balanced_profile_transfer_is_wrong']
suite=unittest.TestSuite(t.ComparisonCLI(name) for name in names)
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
s={'scope':'new15 only; not full acceptance','tests_run':r.testsRun,'failures':len(r.failures),'errors':len(r.errors),'success':r.wasSuccessful(),'code':t.code_identity(),'commands':t.COMMAND_RECORDS}
(t.LOG_ROOT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(s,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
raise SystemExit(0 if r.wasSuccessful() else 1)
